add.event: 设立第二合众国银行的法案经国会通过并由麦迪逊总统签署
add.evidence: The measure was passed by Congress and signed by President James Madison in April 1816.

add.event: 第二合众国银行以二十年特许状开始运营
add.evidence: The Second Bank of the United States began operations in January 1817 under a twenty-year charter.

add.event: 棉花价值单日下跌25%的消息传来，恐慌使美国陷入衰退
add.evidence: When news arrived in January 1819 that the value of cotton had broken—dropping 25% in a single day—the ensuing panic drove the country into recession.

add.event: 国会通过《公共土地债务人救济法》
add.evidence: In 1821, Congress passed the Relief for Public Land Debtors Act.
